intro: tesla man gazes up at the stars from the factory roof.
Earth is slow, bureaucratic, and severely lacking in rocket boosters.
To fund the Mars colony, he must conquer every rival on the mat.

before.line: tesla, you build great things, but your rockets don't pay enough tariff!
Regulations are mind viruses. I'll dash through your border wall.

after_win.line: Zero tariffs in low Earth orbit. First principles victory.

before.line: I wrote the first check for your lab! You owe me equity and respect.
I owe you a product drop. Let's see your humanoid bot try this.

after_win.line: Optimus could have landed that punch in software v12.

before.line: Full self-driving runs on my silicon, tesla. Show some gratitude.
We're building our own chips. Full vertical integration, baby!

after_win.line: Hardware supply chain secured. Order ten thousand more anyway.

before.line: tesla, our search trends show strong interest in your battery life.
Stop searching and start building! Falcon Heavy beats your cloud!

after_win.line: Search query: how to survive a supersonic left jab.

before.line: Any cage, anytime, anywhere! I've been doing literal push-ups!
I have logged four thousand hours in the octagon. Ready to spar.

after_win.line: Cage match concluded. Now delete your thread.

before.line: Autonomous entity detected. Efficiency rating sub-optimal.
I warned humanity about you in 2014! Time to unplug the mainframe!

after_win.line: AGI defeated. Now downloading your neural weights into my pickup.

ending: tesla man plants a flag on the red sands of Mars.
The Cybertruck hums quietly under the alien sky.
Next goal: colonise the outer moons and fix the horn sound.
